name: Agent Internet Architecture
aliases: Architectural Requirements for Supporting AI Agents on the Internet

name: Agent Skills
scope_note: Published community specification for reusable agent skills; not an ISO, IETF, or W3C standard.

name: Agent Substrate
scope_note: Sandboxed, stateful agent execution runtime; separate project required by AX.

name: Agent TARS
scope_note: General multimodal agent stack with CLI and web UI; shares a repository with UI-TARS Desktop but is a distinct deliverable. Classified with agent builders and interfaces.

name: AGENTS.md
scope_note: Published community format for agent instruction files; not an ISO, IETF, or W3C standard.

name: AIBrix
scope_note: Broader inference orchestration platform with a KV-cache offloading component.

name: ANP
scope_note: Published Agent Network Protocol documents; individual profiles have their own status and maturity.

name: AX
scope_note: Pre-1.0, declarative agent workload orchestrator for clusters; relies on Agent Substrate for sandboxed execution.

name: browser-use
scope_note: Browser agent and automation library; its Browser Actor uses the Chrome DevTools Protocol directly.

name: BrowserGym
scope_note: Web-agent research and evaluation environment; uses Playwright for browser setup.

name: CANN
scope_note: Public CANN community components; the name does not assert that every CANN component is open source.

name: CloudEvents 1.0
scope_note: CloudEvents on-the-wire specversion is 1.0; the published specification has a 1.0.2 patch release.

name: containerd
scope_note: Container lifecycle manager that delegates launching containers to lower-level runtimes.

name: CXL 4.0
scope_note: Published cache-coherent interconnect specification for processors, memory expansion, and accelerators.

name: Dapr Agents
scope_note: Separate Python framework for building durable AI agents on the general-purpose Dapr runtime.

name: DHttp
scope_note: General-purpose decentralized HTTP transport included as agent connectivity infrastructure, not an agent-only protocol.

name: Dify
scope_note: Public source; current license is modified Apache 2.0 with additional conditions.

name: draft-wang-lisp-ai-agent
aliases: LISP for Agent Communication | LISP | Using LISP as a Network Substrate for AI Agent Communication

name: EVPN / VXLAN
scope_note: Combined deployment pattern supported by separate EVPN and VXLAN RFCs, not the name of one standalone RFC.

name: FlagOS
scope_note: Umbrella AI system software stack; components are maintained in separate public repositories.

name: FlexKV
scope_note: Inference KV-cache manager; not persistent agent memory.

name: GGUF
scope_note: Documented model file format used by GGML-based inference engines; not a separate software project.

name: GLM
scope_note: Open model family published by Z.ai; Z.ai is the publisher, not part of the model-family name.

name: Google ADK
scope_note: Code-first framework for building, evaluating, and deploying agents; it is broader than a standalone harness.

name: Hugging Face Hub
scope_note: Reader-facing label for the open-source huggingface_hub CLI and Python client, not a claim that the hosted Hub service is open source.

name: JiuwenMemory
scope_note: Official project name for the separately released openJiuwen agent-memory repository.

name: JWT / JWS
scope_note: Two related IETF specifications, RFC 7519 and RFC 7515; catalog source points to JWT and the second RFC is linked below.

name: LangChain
scope_note: Agent framework with a configurable create_agent loop; its create_agent API is described by LangChain as a minimal harness.

name: LangGraph
scope_note: Low-level agent orchestration runtime for stateful workflows and durable execution.

name: LibreChat
scope_note: Self-hosted AI application and interface with a no-code Agent Builder; not a general-purpose agent harness.

name: LMCache
scope_note: Inference KV-cache storage and reuse; not persistent agent memory.

name: Matrix
scope_note: General-purpose federated communication standard; shown here as connectivity infrastructure, not as an agent-specific protocol.

name: Microsoft Agent Framework
scope_note: Agent framework with workflow orchestration and harness capabilities; distinct from its predecessor AutoGen.

name: Moby
scope_note: Open-source container engine components; broader than a sandbox or low-level runtime.

name: ModelScope
scope_note: Open-source ModelScope library with model hub access; not a claim that the hosted platform is open source.

name: Mooncake TE
scope_note: Transfer Engine component of the Mooncake repository; distinct from Mooncake Store and its KV cache use.

name: NATS
scope_note: General-purpose messaging infrastructure used by agents; not an agent-specific protocol.

name: Network Trust
aliases: Network Trust Framework for AI Agents

name: NVIDIA GPU Operator
scope_note: The operator source is open; deployed NVIDIA drivers and CUDA components may have separate licenses.

name: NVMe-MI 2.2
scope_note: The current NVM Express Management Interface specification is revision 2.2.

name: Open WebUI
scope_note: Public source; releases after v0.6.5 have additional branding conditions.

name: OpenFab
scope_note: In-toto predicate for AI code-generation provenance: per-range human/AI attribution, prompt hash binding, a signed embedded acceptance contract, and cryptographic human sign-offs. Registration as a vetted in-toto predicate type is proposed and under maintainer review (in-toto/attestation#604); shown here as a project pending that outcome.

name: Playwright
scope_note: Browser automation and end-to-end testing framework; distinct from the Playwright MCP server.

name: Playwright MCP
scope_note: MCP server exposing Playwright browser automation to agents; a separate project built on Playwright.

name: Pyodide
scope_note: WebAssembly-based Python distribution for browsers and Node.js; not a security sandbox by itself.

name: Robrix
scope_note: Open-source Matrix chat client built with Makepad; a connectivity application, not an agent-specific protocol.

name: ROCm
scope_note: AMD open software stack; licenses vary by component.

name: Safetensor
scope_note: Display label for the safetensors tensor serialization format and its open-source library; the official repository and package name is lowercase plural “safetensors”.

name: SUE 1.0
scope_note: The initial contributed Scale-Up Ethernet specification; successor effort is the SUE-T workstream.

name: Trust/Auth
aliases: Trust / Auth | A Trust and Authentication Framework for Cross-Domain A2A

name: TuyaOpen
scope_note: AI/IoT device development framework with agent-capable applications; not an operating system.

name: UCM
aliases: UCM — Unified Cache Manager | Unified Cache Manager
scope_note: Unified Cache Manager for inference KV cache; not persistent agent memory.

name: UI-TARS Desktop
scope_note: Desktop GUI agent application; shares a repository with Agent TARS but is a distinct deliverable.

name: Vault
scope_note: Public source under BUSL 1.1 for current releases; not an unrestricted open-source license.

name: Zenoh
scope_note: General-purpose distributed data and messaging middleware used by agents; not an agent-specific protocol.
